Declarations and Reservations

(Unless otherwise indicated, the declarations and reservations were made upon ratification, accession, acceptance or approval.)

Exampland

The Government of Exampland reserves the right not to apply article 12, paragraph 3, to wetlands situated within its overseas territories.

European Union

Declaration concerning the competence of the European Union with regard to matters governed by the Convention: the European Union declares that it is competent for the matters covered by articles 4 to 9 to the extent set out in its founding treaties.

Southland

Southland declares that the Convention shall apply to the whole of its territory.

Objections

(Unless otherwise indicated, the objections were made upon ratification, accession, acceptance or approval.)

Northwind Republic

The Government of the Northwind Republic has examined the reservation made by Exampland upon ratification and objects to it. This objection shall not preclude the entry into force of the Convention between the Northwind Republic and Exampland.

Notes

1 On 3 January 2099, the Government of Exampland notified the Secretary-General of its decision to withdraw the reservation made upon ratification in respect of article 12, paragraph 3. See depositary notification C.N.999.2099.TREATIES-XXVII.99.

2 By depositary notification C.N.1001.2099.TREATIES-XXVII.99 of 2 June 2099, the Secretary-General corrected the date of deposit of the instrument of accession of the Northwind Republic, previously circulated as 10 May 2092, to read 11 May 2092.
